scenario.situation: The student has just moved to Jeddah for work and is spending Friday with a Hijazi colleague: shopping in Al-Balad, taking a bus along the corniche and having lunch at a restaurant.
scenario.studentRole: A newcomer to Jeddah learning Saudi (Hijazi) Arabic.
scenario.otherRole: A helpful Hijazi colleague who shows them around.
scenario.goalEnglish: Talk about your daily routine and new job, buy clothes and vegetables, ask for directions and the fare, and order food at a restaurant.
